item.content:encoded:
Simpler solution:

Lead is one of the most stable elements, and there's a reason so many of the heavy elements have a decay chain that ends in lead. It's not hard to imagine this stability extends to more metaphysical concepts, like simplicity—after all, 82 one of the 'magic numbers' in electron shells, and lead's number 82.

As a possible example, imagine if the simplicity starts on the macro scale, and begins proceeding further and further into the micro scale; eventually you're trying to simplify atomic structure, and lead's stability inhibits that.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Splendid job on your first article. I'm curious as to why the lead is so much more immune. My first theory is that the creature is outputting some type of radiation, of which the lead inhibits propagation of. This, however, is easily debunked if the creature is in a lead cell. If the surroundings OUTSIDE this cell are still simplifying, then the lead isn't stopping any radiation. Therefore, something other attribute about the lead makes it more immune. My second theory is that lead, being a natural element, has very little in it's chemical makeup that would be simplified. If it was a complex molecule, I could see that having "room" for simplification. An easy way to test this would be to see the reaction of pure gold upon exposure. Gold, being even simpler than lead, should react similarly if the second theory is sound. If not, then I'm at a loss.

All this questioning is definitely indicative of an interesting SCP that really gets your gears moving and thinking. Great job.
